senses.gloss: Krakucchandaka, = prec. (1) if reading is correct: LV 〔260.11〕 (vs) ˚dakasya; but Tib. (not included in Foucauxʼs ed.) seems to have had a different reading, without this name, see Foucauxʼs transl., and his 〔Notes p. 162〕.
? krakūnikā, Mmk 〔395.26〕, in a description of a hand-position: saṃkocita-krakūnikā-granthānya-prayogāvasthita- (what follows is corrupt). Meaning? Probably corrupt.

krandanā (or ˚na, m.), a kind of malevolent supernatural being, in a list of such: krandanā mahākrandanāḥ Mmk 〔17.8〕. The immediately surrounding terms in the list are fem., but masc. ones occur not far away.
krandita, nt. (= Skt. Lex.; Pali kandita), crying, lamentation: LV 〔372.21〕 (vs) iha rudita-kranditānāṃ … paryantaṃ.
(krayika, m., once in Mbh., BR, dealer, buyer, purchaser: [] Mv 〔ii.242.4〕 sakuntakānāṃ krayiko, 6 śakuntakrayiko; Divy 〔505.6〕 māṃsasyá krayiko.)
krāyika, m. = krayika, krāyaka: Divy 〔505.8〕 yatra krāyiko 'sti (cf. krayika in 6 above).
krāyaka, m. (Skt. Lex. id.), purchaser: Śikṣ 〔38.3〕 ˚kaṃ na labhate; 〔8, 12〕; AsP 〔497.17〕 ˚ko labdho. Cf. prec. and next.
